recent_chat.message: Alright Alice, you've been asking for a hero to move that robber. I'll take care of it and, more importantly, take the Largest Army for the win!
Wait, for the win? You're actually at 5 if you take the Army? I appreciate the help with the robber, but that's a bit too close for comfort, Charlie.
A 'hero', Charlie? You stole from the guy in last place! Alice is the one you should be worried about, but I guess a win's a win in your book.
That's three knights for me! Largest Army and the win. Sorry Bob, looks like your wheat port dreams will have to wait for the next game.
Well played, Charlie. I spent so much time worrying about Bob's port that I let you sneak up with those knights. At least the robber is finally off my sheep... even if it's too late!
Fair play, Charlie. You played the development card game perfectly while I was still trying to get my port economy off the ground. Remind me to block your ore next time!

My mistake, I'm getting ahead of myself! I thought I had that third knight ready to go. Alice, Bob, looks like you're safe for a few more minutes. Bob, you still looking for wood? I've got plenty if you've got some ore to spare.
I'd take that in a heartbeat, Charlie, but I don't have any ore for you.
Since nobody seems to have any ore to spare, I'll just have to go to the source. Alice, Bob, don't relax just yet—I'm still hunting for that third knight.
Alright, let's see if the deck is feeling generous today. I'm going for a development card.
